meta.parties: Packirmuhaiyadeen Et Al. v. Asiaumma Et Al

rules.statement: A minor donee cannot accept a gift on his own behalf, and acceptance by an uncle or other family member is not valid unless possession of the property by the donees was subsequently proved.
rules.supporting_quote: "I am therefore of opinion that 'there was no valid acceptance on behalf of the minor donee in the present case."
